name: prosell-market
description: ProSell Market — frontend + GAS backend deploy automation

scripts.repo:push: git add . && git diff --cached --quiet && echo 'Nothing to commit, skipping push' || (git commit -m 'Auto deploy: $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")' && git push origin main)
scripts.deploy:all: npm run repo:push && npm run gas:push && npm run gas:deploy
